title: Facebook Ads to Instagram Stories: How to Turn Story Views into Booked Calls
metaTitle: Facebook Ads to Instagram Stories: How to Turn Story Views into Booked Calls - Mochi
description: Blog: This guide explains how Facebook ads can appear as Instagram Stories, why the DM follow-up matters more than the click, and how coaches and creators can turn story views into qualified booked calls instead of losing leads in a messy inbox.
label: Blog

cover.alt: A split-screen visual: one side shows a Meta Ads Manager dashboard with a Stories placement selected, the other side shows a phone with an Instagram Story ad and a DM notification. The contrast should suggest that the story ad is only the beginning of the sales conversation.

blocks.name: Content 1
blocks.html:
Why the click is only the beginning

If you sell a course, coaching offer or digital product, you have probably run ads on Facebook and Instagram. You know the mechanics: create an ad, pick your audience, choose your placement and hope the clicks turn into sales.

But here is what most coaches and creators miss. When you run a Facebook ad with Instagram Stories as a placement, the person who sees your ad can tap and end up in your DMs. That person is warm, interested and already raised their hand. The click is not the finish line. It is the start of a conversation.

The problem is that Instagram shows your newest DM at the top of the inbox. The person who just tapped your Story ad might be sitting below somebody who sent a compliment two minutes ago. Your team answers the wrong people first, and the warm lead from your ad goes cold.

That is why connecting Facebook ads to Instagram Stories only works when you also have a system for the conversations those ads start.

blocks.name: Content 2
blocks.html:
What happens after someone taps

Imagine you run an ad for your fitness program. The ad appears as an Instagram Story. Someone taps the call-to-action and lands in your DMs, ready to learn more. Now what?

If you are a solo founder, you try to reply fast. But one ad can bring in dozens of messages, and each one expects a personal answer. If you have a setter or a small team, the inbox becomes even messier. Nobody knows who replied already, who is qualified and who still needs a follow-up.

A person might ask a question and then wait hours for a reply. By the time your team gets to them, they have moved on. The money you spent on the ad is wasted because the lead disappeared in the inbox.

This is the part most ad guides ignore. They teach you how to write the ad, how to target and how to budget. They do not teach you what happens after the tap. That is where the sale is actually won or lost.

blocks.name: Content 3
blocks.html:
Prioritize the right conversations

The fix is not to reply faster. It is to prioritize the right conversations and give your team the context they need.

Start with the simple principle: not every new message deserves the same attention. The person who tapped your Story ad and asked about the program is more valuable than somebody who replied with an emoji. Your team should see those leads first.

That means you need more than an Instagram inbox. You need a system that shows you who is qualified, who needs a follow-up and who already received your calendar link. You need to know which of your ads actually created booked calls, not just clicks and views.

A simple manual improvement is to mark or label important conversations in Instagram. But that stops working when you have five, ten or fifty conversations moving at once. You need a dedicated way to organize the sales conversations that your ads start.

blocks.name: Content 4
blocks.html:
Build a DM follow-through process

The businesses that win with Facebook ads and Instagram Stories do not treat the DM as an afterthought. They have a clear process.

First, they connect the ad to a keyword or a Story reply so the conversation starts automatically while the interest is fresh.

Second, they make sure the setter sees the most important leads first.

Third, they track what happens after the first message: who replied, who became qualified, who opened the calendar link and who booked a call.


That is exactly what Mochi helps you do. Mochi is the Instagram DM sales system for coaches, creators and info businesses. It helps your team focus on the right people, understand the full conversation and see which ads and Stories are actually creating revenue.


Instead of guessing which ad brought you that qualified lead, Mochi connects the conversation back to the source. You can see the exact Story that started it and how many booked calls that ad created. You stop judging ads by views and start judging them by sales.
